calculation.expression: clip(-(return_1 - rolling_beta_60(return_1, cross_sectional_median_return_1) * cross_sectional_median_return_1) * (1 + 0.30 * abs(clip((spread_change_5 - rolling_median_120(spread_change_5)) / (rolling_median_120(abs(spread_change_5 - rolling_median_120(spread_change_5))) + 1e-6), -3, 3)), -0.2, 0.2)
calculation.description: For each tradable asset, reverse its one-day return residual after a 60-day rolling beta to the cross-sectional median return. Amplify the reversal when the five-day log US10Y/CN10Y spread change is unusual relative to its rolling 120-day median/MAD. US10Y and CN10Y are tradable benchmark series and are used as conditioning inputs, not observation-only order symbols. All inputs are lagged/current completed-day data for decision use.

validation.regime_notes: Positive daily IC in all three broad regimes; uncertainty remains material because the cross-section has 15 instruments. Daily IC and ICIR pass benchmark admission gates; five-day decay remains positive.
